title: Mandarin Oriental Marrakech Launches 'Villa for a Day' — Private Pool and Butler Included
body:
The Mandarin Oriental Marrakech now offers non-residents exclusive use of a private villa for the day — complete with private pool, personal butler, gourmet lunch for two, and full resort access from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Pricing and Booking

Priced at approximately 2,800 MAD for two guests. Spa treatments available at extra cost. Advance booking of 48 hours minimum required. Available Thursday through Monday only — availability is tight in summer.

Source: MadeInCity Marrakech and Mandarin Oriental Marrakech.
